# Planview Hub - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Integration platform that synchronises work items across software delivery and portfolio tools (for example Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow).

Also known as: Hub, Tasktop, Tasktop Integration Hub. Solution areas: Digital Product Development, Value Stream Management. Deployment: SaaS, On-premises.

## Capabilities

- **Toolchain integration** - a core capability of Planview Hub: Synchronise work items across delivery tools (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow).

## Implementation considerations

- Model artifact mappings (e.g. epic/feature/story) and conflict rules per integration before go-live.
- On-premises deployment availability to be confirmed with Planview for the customer's scenario.
